units.source_text: 右大臣的本性，万事想到就说，不能隐藏在心。

en.t: The Minister of the Right was by nature a man who said whatever came to mind and could not keep it hidden in his heart.

units.source_text: 加之老年之人，都有直率之癖。

en.t: Besides, old people all tend to have a habit of speaking frankly.

units.source_text: 因此绝不踌躇，把这件事一五一十地向弘徽殿太后诉说了。

en.t: So he did not hesitate at all, but told the Empress Mother of Kokiden the whole affair in full detail.

units.source_text: 他说：“有这样的事情。

en.t: He said, "Such a thing has happened.

units.source_text: 这怀纸正是右大将的手笔。

en.t: This folded paper is unmistakably in the handwriting of the Captain of the Right.

units.source_text: 以前早有暧昧之事。

en.t: There had already been something suspicious between them before.

units.source_text: 当时我因看重他的人品，

en.t: At that time, because I valued his character,

units.source_text: 不曾向他问罪，并且说过愿将女儿嫁给他。

en.t: I did not hold him to account, and even said that I would be willing to give him my daughter in marriage.

units.source_text: 当时他却毫不在意，一味态度冷淡。

en.t: Yet at the time he paid no attention to it at all and remained only cold and indifferent.

units.source_text: 我心甚是愤慨。

en.t: I was deeply indignant at heart.

units.source_text: 但念此或前世因缘，也就曲意原谅。

en.t: But thinking that this might be a bond from a former life, I forced myself to forgive him.

units.source_text: 我想此女虽已失身，

en.t: I thought that although this girl had already lost her chastity,

units.source_text: 朱雀帝抑或宽宏大量，并不摒弃。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku might perhaps be magnanimous and not reject her.

units.source_text: 经我恳愿，居然容许入宫，遂我初志。

en.t: After my earnest pleading, she was unexpectedly allowed to enter the palace, fulfilling my original wish.

units.source_text: 但因负疚在心，不敢奢望女御之尊，

en.t: But because I felt guilty, I did not dare hope for the honored rank of imperial consort,

units.source_text: 只得让她屈居尚侍之位，在我已是一大遗憾。

en.t: and had no choice but to let her settle for the position of Naishi no Kami, which was already a great regret to me.

units.source_text: 如今此女身已入宫，他又做出此种行为，

en.t: Now that this girl has already entered the palace, he has gone and done such a thing again,

units.source_text: 更加使我痛心疾首。

en.t: which makes me feel even more heartbroken and bitterly distressed.

units.source_text: 寻花问柳虽是男子常有之事，

en.t: Although chasing women is something men often do,

units.source_text: 但这大将实在岂有此理！

en.t: this Captain has truly behaved beyond all reason!
